Clearbit — person enrichment, company enrichment, prospecting, and reveal (identify website visitors).

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Clearbit skill for OpenClaw agents.
- Person and company enrichment, prospecting, and website visitor reveal via Clearbit API.
- Python 3.10+ support with no external dependencies.
- Command-line interface supports lookups by email, domain, IP, and company name.
- Requires CLEARBIT_API_KEY environment variable.
- All commands output results as JSON.
